content: The info panel is where an agent stops being yours alone. Invite people to it, or give view-only access so they can read what it produced without touching how it works. The history says what changed in the agent, and when.

comment.text: Description text for an onboarding tour step explaining how the Info Panel manages agent sharing, access permissions, and activity history.
